plan.title: Adipose treated vs control DE adjusted for sex and age
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is 12 adipose bulk RNA-seq samples (6 treated, 6 control) quantified with Salmon, with sex and age recorded per sample but the groups not matched on age. Because age and sex could confound the treatment effect if left out, and because the raw integer counts already come from Salmon gene-summarized quantification, the plan runs a single DESeq2 model with a design that includes sex and centered age alongside condition, rather than a naive two-group t-test that would let an age or sex imbalance masquerade as a treatment effect. Steps: (1) confirm sample structure and check whether age/sex or an unmeasured factor dominates the top variance components before trusting the model, (2) minimal count pre-filter, (3) DESeq2 Wald test on the condition coefficient from the covariate-adjusted design with median-of-ratios normalization internal to the model, (4) apeglm shrinkage of the condition log2 fold change, (5) BH-adjusted independent filtering at alpha 0.05 to call significant genes, (6) preranked fgsea against MSigDB Hallmark, Reactome, and WikiPathways gene sets (all confirmed present for human) using the Wald statistic as the ranking metric, and (7) a consolidated report with fit diagnostics, the gene table, and a full reproducibility record. Age is a continuous covariate and is centered before the fit per the design-matrix guidance; sex and condition are factors with an explicit reference level (control). Because n=6 per group is at the low end of the replicate range, DESeq2's per-cell outlier handling (Cook's distance flag to NA rather than replacement, since cell size <7) is kept on and reported explicitly rather than silently applied.

steps.method: keep gene with >=10 counts in >= smallest group size (n=6)
design = ~ sex + age_centered + condition, explicit reference level control
DESeq2 Wald test on condition treated vs control, adjusted for sex and age
apeglm shrinkage of the condition coefficient
fgsea preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic, Hallmark then Reactome and WikiPathways
DE + enrichment report with diagnostics, reproducibility record
